/** Make it easier to iterate over format IDs */
inline SotClipboardFormatId& operator++(SotClipboardFormatId& eFormat)
{
    eFormat = static_cast<SotClipboardFormatId>(static_cast<sal_uInt32>(eFormat) + 1);
    return eFormat;
}
